get.summary: Check if a user exists by email or phone
Get lookup data from specified table
get.description:
Get reference data from lookup tables.

**Independent tables** (no parentId required):
- countries
- industries
- employmentTypes
- skills
- tools
- serviceCategories
- workLocations
- educationLevels
- engagementModels
- experienceLevels
- currencies

**Dependent tables** (parentId required):
- states (requires countryId)
- cities (requires stateId)
- courses (requires educationLevelId)

Examples:
- GET /lookup?table=countries
- GET /lookup?table=states&parentId=1
- GET /lookup?table=cities&parentId=2

post.summary: Populate lookup tables with sample data (debug only)
post.description:
Populate all lookup tables with sample data if they are empty (count = 0).

**Tables that will be populated:**
- countries, states, cities (geographic data)
- industries (business sectors)
- employmentTypes (job types)
- skills (technical skills)
- tools (development tools)
- serviceCategories (service types)
- workLocations (work arrangements)
- educationLevels (education levels)
- engagementModels (engagement types)
- experienceLevels (experience levels)
- currencies (currency types)
- courses (educational courses)
